items.why: Meta Connect halo effect: Muse AI is coming to its glasses, new Ray Ban and Oakley AI glasses lineup, $1,299 VR glasses and a Muse Charm pendant. Wells Fargo also raised its target to $1,000 last week.
Profit taking after record highs. The stock broke below $620 support, ARK Invest sold about $15.8 million, and the SOXX just posted its worst week in a month on AI spending concerns.
Crude rallied to $93.75 on fresh energy strikes in Ukraine and Middle East supply risk, per the WSJ, with the Dow higher and Nasdaq lower in mixed holiday tape.
Caught in the chip selloff: SOXX down 5% last week on OpenAI spending questions and new DRAM competition from China's CXMT weighing on the semis.

market_note: S&P flat near records, Nasdaq lower on chip weakness, Dow higher as oil rallies. Big bank earnings start Tuesday.
summary: Stocks mixed near records Monday as Meta's Connect news powered gains while chip stocks lagged and oil jumped. Columbus Day keeps the bond market closed with bank earnings up next.
